_comment: sign_id -> animation clip. type: 'captured' (retargeted from a recorded webcam sample) or 'placeholder' (hand-written illustrative motion, NOT verified ISL). 'review' is the sign validation checklist (handshape, orientation, movement, location, non_manual = facial/body components): each is 'unchecked' | 'ok' | 'wrong'. Set verified=true only after an ISL-proficient reviewer marks every item 'ok' against a named reference.
